youtube.title: Space is black, so why is the sky blue? 🌍 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Space is pitch black and sunlight is white, so why does the sky look blue? Sunlight is every colour mixed together, and each colour is a wave of a different length. Tiny nitrogen and oxygen molecules in our air knock the short blue waves in every direction, so blue light reaches you from all over the sky. Full episode on the channel.

#Shorts #science #sky #explainer #thehiddenwhy
